name.en-US: A Treatise on Prayer and Meditation (Chester, 1862)
name.pt-BR: Tratado da oração e meditação (Chester, inglês, 1862)

description.en-US: A Victorian English rendering, in 31 chapters, of Louis of Granada's Libro de la oración y meditación: the fruits of prayer, the six points of its exercise, the fourteen meditations for the mornings and nights of the week and their considerations, and the counsels on devotion. It is condensed and re-divided against the Spanish, so it is its own book.
description.pt-BR: Versão inglesa vitoriana (Chester, 1862) do Libro de la oración y meditación de Luís de Granada, em 31 capítulos.

en-US.translator: anonymous, one of the congregation of the Capuchin oratory of St. Francis, Chester

sources.edition: A Treatise on Prayer and Meditation, translated from the Spanish of Fray Luis de Granada, Chester: Griffith, printer, 1862 (in aid of the building fund of the new church of St. Francis, Chester). Internet Archive scan treatiseonprayer0000luis.
sources.description: Internet Archive OCR, split at the chapter headings; running heads and page numbers are dropped and line-break hyphens joined. The translator's dedication and appeal "To the Purchaser" and the table of contents are not included; isolated recognition slips remain.
sources.tierEvidence: Published 1862, before 1930; public domain in the US.
